summary: Whoopee Camp's cult PlayStation platform-adventure duology, revived through Limited Run Games' Carbon Engine Special Editions.

entries.title: Tomba!

emulation.emulator: Carbon Engine in Special Edition; DuckStation for owned original discs
emulation.notes: Use Special Edition for normal play; original PlayStation emulation is for comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation presentation with Carbon Engine conveniences and museum extras.

primary.why: Tomba! Special Edition is the most complete official route because it runs the original game through Carbon Engine with save states, museum material, and an arranged soundtrack; the PC version is the best capture-friendly platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tomba! Special Edition on Steam/PC. Use the original PlayStation release or PSN version only for historical comparison.

all_releases.reason: skip: historically original, but Special Edition adds modern emulator conveniences and museum content.
skip: older digital route, no sourced extras over the original beyond PSOne Classics access.

all_releases.fidelity: Later PS4 release of Tomba! Special Edition.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Special Edition is both the most complete official package and the easiest current route.
